boundaryZh: 本文件记录 EcoMOF-AI 的方法灵感、需求分类和证据边界；除明确标注为 validated literature 的条目外，不作为候选材料性能证明。
boundaryEn: This file records method inspiration, requirement classes, and evidence boundaries for EcoMOF-AI. Unless marked as validated literature, entries are not performance evidence for any candidate material.

categories.purposeZh: 解释为什么 EcoMOF-AI 采用证据分层、字段溯源、结构化因素效应和小样本验证闭环。
categories.purposeEn: Explains why EcoMOF-AI uses evidence tiers, field provenance, structured factor effects, and small-sample validation loops.

categories.purposeZh: 把吸附性能、工作容量、再生负担、稳定性、绿色合成、LCA/LCC 与金属供应风险拆成可检查的数据需求。
categories.purposeEn: Splits adsorption performance, working capacity, regeneration burden, stability, green synthesis, LCA/LCC, and metal-supply risk into inspectable data requirements.

categories.purposeZh: 支撑 GasSep 不只展示容量，还联动选择性、工作容量、再生性、吸附热和证据等级。
categories.purposeEn: Supports GasSep using selectivity, working capacity, regenerability, heat of adsorption, and evidence level rather than uptake alone.

categories.titleZh: MOF 候选库与身份溯源
categories.purposeZh: 支撑 CoRE/QMOF 结构记录、NIST 吸附记录和身份映射的分层展示；无法确认的结构、气体与催化记录保持独立。
categories.purposeEn: Supports layered CoRE/QMOF structures, NIST adsorption records, and identity mapping; unresolved structure, gas, and catalysis records remain separate.

categories.purposeZh: 保留原有有机酸/催化文献灵感，包括腔内/表面机制、耦合描述符热区图和验证梯度。
categories.purposeEn: Preserves the original organic-acid and catalysis inspiration, including in-cavity/surface mechanisms, coupled-descriptor hot spots, and validation ladders.

categories.titleZh: 数据质量、验证与报告边界
categories.titleEn: Data Quality, Validation, And Reporting Boundary
categories.purposeZh: 把文献、实验、模拟、演示和待核验数据分开处理，避免把排序解释误读为最终推荐。
categories.purposeEn: Separates literature, experimental, simulated, demonstration, and pending data so ranking explanations are not misread as final recommendations.

sources.title: Data-Driven Design of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Efficient Coalbed Methane Purification: From Molecular Fingerprint Mining to Experimental Validation
sources.authors: Guoqiang Che; Pengtao Guo; Miao Chang; Qingyuan Yang; Dahuan Liu
sources.coreIdeaZh: 将分子指纹挖掘、反向设计与实验验证串联起来的数据驱动 MOF 设计路线。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Data-driven MOF design links molecular fingerprint mining, reverse design, and experimental validation.
sources.adoptedInZh: 描述符驱动候选解释、验证证据梯度、小样本验证路线。
sources.adoptedInEn: Descriptor-driven candidate interpretation, validation evidence ladder, and small-sample validation route.
sources.boundaryZh: 仅借鉴工作流，不复现 CH4/N2 分离模型或 Ni-BIC 结果。
sources.boundaryEn: Workflow-level inspiration only; EcoMOF-AI does not reproduce the CH4/N2 model or Ni-BIC result.

sources.title: AI-Powered Experimental Discovery of Metal-Organic Frameworks for n/i-Butane Separation
sources.authors: metadata pending
sources.coreIdeaZh: 用 integrated descriptors 与相似性采样降低筛选成本，并保持描述符可由实验或模拟获得。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Integrated descriptors and similarity-based sampling reduce screening cost while keeping descriptors experimentally or computationally accessible.
sources.adoptedInZh: 小规模真实样例、CoRE/QMOF 映射、描述符覆盖审查。
sources.adoptedInEn: Small real examples, CoRE/QMOF mapping, and descriptor-coverage review.
sources.boundaryZh: 目标是 n/i-butane 分离；元数据核查前不作为 DOI-backed 证据引用。
sources.boundaryEn: Target is n/i-butane separation; do not cite as DOI-backed evidence until metadata is verified.

sources.title: The geometric-electronic coupled design of diatomic catalyst towards oxygen reduction reaction
sources.authors: Yan Liu; Yan Yang; Xuanni Lin; Yutao Lin; Zhiwen Zhuo; Dong Liu; Junjie Mao; Jun Jiang
sources.coreIdeaZh: 用几何与电子描述符构建催化热区图，辅助双原子催化剂设计。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Uses geometric and electronic descriptors to build catalytic hot-spot maps for diatomic catalyst design.
sources.adoptedInZh: 耦合描述符热区图、支架图/掺杂图/协同图、验证梯度。
sources.adoptedInEn: Coupled-descriptor hot-spot map, scaffold/dopant/synergy views, and validation ladder.
sources.boundaryZh: 只借鉴可视化哲学，不复现 ORR 模型、DFT 数据集或实验结论。
sources.boundaryEn: Visualization philosophy only; EcoMOF-AI does not reproduce the ORR model, DFT dataset, or experimental claim.

sources.title: Modelling and estimation of chemical reaction yields from high-throughput experiments
sources.authors: metadata pending
sources.coreIdeaZh: 高通量化学数据具有数据生成结构，直接黑箱建模容易产生误导。
sources.coreIdeaEn: High-throughput chemical data has a data-generation structure, and black-box modeling can be misleading if that structure is ignored.
sources.adoptedInZh: 数据质量门控、结构化因素效应、稳健性审计和解释边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: Data-quality gates, structured factor effects, robustness audit, and interpretation boundaries.
sources.boundaryZh: 讨论 HTE 产率建模，不是 MOF 筛选或有机酸性能证据。
sources.boundaryEn: Addresses HTE yield modeling, not MOF screening or organic-acid performance evidence.

sources.title: Machine Learning Reveals In-Cavity Versus Surface Activity for Selective C-H Borylation by Metal-Organic Framework Catalysts
sources.authors: Su et al. (metadata pending)
sources.coreIdeaZh: 用可解释 MOF 描述符族区分腔内活性、表面活性和缺陷位点活性。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Uses interpretable MOF descriptor families to distinguish in-cavity activity from surface or defect-site activity.
sources.adoptedInZh: 腔内/表面/缺陷机制分支、机理雷达和活性位点解释。
sources.adoptedInEn: In-cavity/surface/defect mechanism branches, mechanism radar, and active-site explanation.
sources.boundaryZh: 研究 Ni-MOF C-H borylation，不是 CO2 到有机酸路径证明。
sources.boundaryEn: Studies Ni-MOF C-H borylation, not proof for CO2-to-organic-acid pathways.

sources.title: Determining objective weights in multiple criteria problems: The CRITIC method
sources.authors: D. Diakoulaki; G. Mavrotas; L. Papayannakis
sources.coreIdeaZh: CRITIC 用指标差异度和指标冲突度生成客观权重。
sources.coreIdeaEn: CRITIC derives objective weights from contrast intensity and conflict among criteria.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen / GasSep 中解释 CRITIC 权重来源和敏感性边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: Explains the origin and sensitivity boundary of CRITIC weights in EcoScreen / GasSep.
sources.boundaryZh: CRITIC 解释排序影响，不证明化学因果机制。
sources.boundaryEn: CRITIC explains ranking influence, not chemical causality.

sources.title: Large-scale screening of hypothetical metal-organic frameworks
sources.authors: C. E. Wilmer et al.
sources.coreIdeaZh: 大规模 MOF 早筛应把结构描述符、吸附模拟和任务目标联系起来。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Large-scale MOF screening links structural descriptors, adsorption simulation, and task targets.
sources.adoptedInZh: Open MOF Seed 候选覆盖、结构描述符覆盖和 Top-N 预览边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: Open MOF Seed coverage, structural descriptor coverage, and Top-N preview boundaries.
sources.boundaryZh: 不表示当前候选已完成同等 GCMC 或过程模拟。
sources.boundaryEn: Does not imply the current candidates have equivalent GCMC or process simulation.

sources.title: Development and evaluation of porous materials for carbon dioxide separation and capture
sources.authors: Youn-Sang Bae; Randall Q. Snurr
sources.coreIdeaZh: CO2 分离评价不能只看单点吸附量，还应关注选择性、工作容量和再生代价。
sources.coreIdeaEn: CO2 separation evaluation should consider selectivity, working capacity, and regeneration burden, not uptake alone.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 和 GasSep 将吸附量、选择性、工作容量、再生性拆开展示。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen and GasSep separate uptake, selectivity, working capacity, and regenerability.
sources.boundaryZh: 当前缺字段时只提示数据缺口，不伪造 IAST/GCMC 结果。
sources.boundaryEn: When fields are missing, EcoMOF-AI flags data gaps instead of fabricating IAST/GCMC results.

sources.title: Water stability and adsorption in metal-organic frameworks
sources.authors: Nicholas C. Burtch; Harpale S. Jasuja; Krista S. Walton
sources.coreIdeaZh: 水稳定性会决定湿气、烟道气或水相条件下的 MOF 适用性。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Water stability determines MOF applicability under humid, flue-gas, or aqueous conditions.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 把水稳定性从普通描述符提升为应用门槛和数据缺口。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen treats water stability as an application gate and data-gap dimension.
sources.boundaryZh: 水稳定性缺失不等于材料失败，但必须进入复核队列。
sources.boundaryEn: Missing water-stability data does not mean material failure, but it must enter the review queue.

sources.title: Green synthesis of metal-organic frameworks: A state-of-the-art review of potential environmental and medical applications
sources.authors: Sandeep Kumar; Shikha Jain; Monika Nehra; Neeraj Dilbaghi; Giovanna Marrazza; Ki Hyun Kim
sources.coreIdeaZh: 绿色 MOF 合成需要关注溶剂、温度、时间、产率、活化步骤和后处理。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Green MOF synthesis requires attention to solvent, temperature, time, yield, activation, and post-processing.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 新增绿色合成字段覆盖，而不把缺失字段直接写入最终分数。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen adds green-synthesis field coverage without writing missing fields directly into the final score.
sources.boundaryZh: 当前没有完整工艺清单时只能作为接入需求和早筛缺口。
sources.boundaryEn: Without a full process inventory, this is a data-ingestion requirement and early-screening gap.

sources.title: Life-cycle assessment as a tool for eco-design of metal-organic frameworks (MOFs)
sources.authors: Carlos A. Grande; Richard Blom; Aud I. Spjelkavik; Valentine Moreau; Jerome Payet
sources.coreIdeaZh: CO2 捕集材料评价需要生命周期视角，避免只看使用阶段性能。
sources.coreIdeaEn: CO2-capture materials need life-cycle framing rather than use-phase performance alone.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 显示 LCA 边界、功能单位和清单字段缺口。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen displays gaps in LCA boundary, functional unit, and inventory fields.
sources.boundaryZh: 没有完整 LCI 时，不输出工程级 LCA 结论。
sources.boundaryEn: Without a complete LCI, EcoMOF-AI does not output engineering-grade LCA conclusions.

sources.title: Toward a sustainable materials basis of metal-organic frameworks for carbon capture and storage technologies
sources.authors: Jingying Hu; Xiangming Gu; Li-Chiang Lin; Bhavik R. Bakshi
sources.coreIdeaZh: MOF 用于碳捕集时需同时考虑材料性能、合成负担和可持续材料基础。
sources.coreIdeaEn: MOFs for carbon capture require joint consideration of material performance, synthesis burden, and sustainable material basis.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 新增供应/成本/合成负担覆盖审查。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen adds coverage review for supply, cost, and synthesis burden.
sources.boundaryZh: 当前为早筛审查，不替代 TEA 或完整 LCA。
sources.boundaryEn: Current use is early screening, not TEA or complete LCA.

sources.title: Techno-economic Analysis of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Hydrogen and Natural Gas Storage
sources.authors: Daniel DeSantis; Jarad A. Mason; Brian D. James; Cassidy Houchins; Jeffrey R. Long; Mike Veenstra
sources.coreIdeaZh: MOF 放大生产成本需要物料与能量衡算、产率、溶剂用量/回收、设备与操作时间；路线选择和固液比是主要敏感因素。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Scaled MOF production cost requires material and energy balances, yield, solvent use/recovery, equipment, and operating time; route choice and solids loading are major sensitivities.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 经济层把材料、公用工程、转化费用和不确定性分开，并把溶剂回收、产率和路线作为可编辑情景。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen separates materials, utilities, conversion allowance, and uncertainty, with solvent recovery, yield, and route as editable scenarios.
sources.boundaryZh: 已发表成本范围针对特定 MOF 和工业规模情景，不直接移植为当前候选报价。
sources.boundaryEn: Published cost ranges apply to specific MOFs and industrial-scale scenarios and are not transplanted as current candidate quotations.

sources.title: Comparative life cycle assessment on zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8) production for CO2 capture
sources.authors: Wenhao Xia; Siew Kei Lau; Wai Fen Yong
sources.coreIdeaZh: 以 1 kg ZIF-8 为功能单位比较七种合成路线，DMF 清洗在多数影响类别中是主要热点，机械化学路线整体影响最低。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Compares seven synthesis routes per 1 kg ZIF-8; DMF washing is a major hotspot in most categories and the mechanochemical route has the lowest overall impact.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 默认提供 1 kg 已活化 MOF 功能单位、路线敏感性和溶剂热点分解。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen provides a default 1 kg activated-MOF functional unit, route sensitivity, and solvent-hotspot decomposition.
sources.boundaryZh: ZIF-8 的路线结论不能自动外推到所有拓扑和化学组成。
sources.boundaryEn: ZIF-8 route results cannot be generalized automatically to every topology and chemistry.

sources.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Metal-Organic Frameworks: Sustainability Study of Zeolitic Imidazolate Framework-67
sources.authors: Harold U. Escobar-Hernandez; Yufeng Quan; Maria I. Papadaki; Qingsheng Wang
sources.coreIdeaZh: 以 1 kg ZIF-67 比较溶剂热和反应挤出路线，说明合成路线可使环境与健康影响跨数量级变化。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Compares solvothermal and reactive-extrusion routes per 1 kg ZIF-67, showing route choice can shift environmental and health impacts by orders of magnitude.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 将路线作为一级情景变量，不再从结构描述符直接推断环境影响。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen treats route as a first-class scenario variable rather than inferring environmental impact directly from structural descriptors.
sources.boundaryZh: 反应挤出可行性必须针对候选单独验证。
sources.boundaryEn: Reactive-extrusion feasibility must be validated for each candidate.

sources.title: Life cycle assessment of CO2 capture through pressure swing adsorption using MOF-74
sources.authors: Pin Wang; Zhen Pan; Zhiming Liu; Liyan Shang; Mohamad Reza Soltanian; Zhien Zhang
sources.journal: Journal of Gas Science and Engineering
sources.coreIdeaZh: MOF 捕集评价需把材料生产、使用和再生放在同一边界中，并对产率与捕集能耗做敏感性和不确定性分析。
sources.coreIdeaEn: MOF capture assessment should place material production, use, and regeneration in one boundary and test yield and capture-energy sensitivity and uncertainty.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 提供按 1 t CO₂ 归一化的可编辑服务情景，并显式加入循环、利用率和再生电力。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen provides an editable 1 t CO2 service scenario with cycles, utilization, and regeneration electricity made explicit.
sources.boundaryZh: 默认服务参数不是 Open MOF Seed 的候选实测值。
sources.boundaryEn: Default service parameters are not candidate measurements from Open MOF Seed.

sources.title: MOF adsorbents for flue gas separation: Comparison of material ranking approaches
sources.authors: Cigdem Altintas; Seda Keskin
sources.coreIdeaZh: 吸附剂排序应避免单指标冠军，需显式处理多目标权衡和可比条件。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Adsorbent ranking should avoid single-metric winners and handle multi-objective tradeoffs under comparable conditions.
sources.adoptedInZh: GasSep / EcoScreen 的多指标排序和条件边界说明。
sources.adoptedInEn: Multi-metric ranking and condition-boundary explanations in GasSep / EcoScreen.
sources.boundaryZh: 排序是研究优先级，不是过程性能证明。
sources.boundaryEn: Ranking is research prioritization, not process-performance proof.

sources.title: An experimental strategy for evaluating the energy performance of metal-organic framework-based carbon dioxide adsorbents
sources.authors: Ji-Peng Luo et al.
sources.coreIdeaZh: 工作容量、吸附热和再生条件会影响吸附过程能耗，不能用容量单独代表过程可用性。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Working capacity, heat of adsorption, and regeneration conditions affect adsorption-process energy, so uptake alone is insufficient.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 新增工作容量、吸附热、再生条件缺口提示。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen adds gap flags for working capacity, heat of adsorption, and regeneration conditions.
sources.boundaryZh: 缺少过程模拟时只显示需求，不计算寄生能。
sources.boundaryEn: Without process simulation, EcoMOF-AI shows requirements rather than calculating parasitic energy.

sources.title: Computation-Ready, Experimental Metal-Organic Frameworks: A Tool To Enable High-Throughput Screening of Nanoporous Crystals
sources.authors: Yongchul G. Chung; Emmanuel Haldoupis; Benjamin J. Bucior; Maciej Haranczyk; David S. Sholl; Randall Q. Snurr et al.
sources.coreIdeaZh: 把实验 MOF 晶体结构整理为可计算数据集，是高通量筛选前的身份、结构和清洗基础。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Curating experimental MOF crystal structures into computation-ready records provides the identity, structure, and cleaning basis for high-throughput screening.
sources.adoptedInZh: MOF 候选库的结构身份层、CoRE 来源说明、字段级溯源和候选记录边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: MOF Library structure identity layer, CoRE source context, field-level provenance, and candidate-record boundaries.
sources.boundaryZh: 说明数据库整理方法，不代表当前记录已完成所有计算或实验复核。
sources.boundaryEn: Explains database curation practice; it does not mean every current record has completed calculation or experimental review.

sources.title: Machine learning the quantum-chemical properties of metal-organic frameworks for accelerated materials discovery
sources.authors: Andrew S. Rosen; Vishnu Fung; Partha P. G. Rudd; Alán Aspuru-Guzik; Laura Gagliardi; Justin M. Notestein; Randall Q. Snurr
sources.coreIdeaZh: QMOF 将量子化学性质、结构记录与机器学习发现流程连接起来。
sources.coreIdeaEn: QMOF connects quantum-chemical properties, structural records, and machine-learning discovery workflows.
sources.adoptedInZh: QMOF 来源字段、量子描述符覆盖审查、结构/性能数据映射。
sources.adoptedInEn: QMOF source fields, quantum-descriptor coverage review, and structure/performance data mapping.
sources.boundaryZh: 用于解释数据层和描述符来源，不把 QMOF 电子性质直接转写为有机酸或气体分离结论。
sources.boundaryEn: Used for data-layer and descriptor provenance, not to convert QMOF electronic properties directly into Organic Acid or gas-separation conclusions.

sources.title: The Chemistry and Applications of Metal-Organic Frameworks
sources.authors: Hiroyasu Furukawa; Kyle E. Cordova; Michael O'Keeffe; Omar M. Yaghi
sources.coreIdeaZh: MOF 的结构可设计性、孔结构和应用多样性决定了筛选界面必须同时展示结构、功能和应用边界。
sources.coreIdeaEn: MOF designability, pore structures, and application breadth explain why screening interfaces need structure, function, and application boundaries together.
sources.adoptedInZh: 全站 MOF 术语、结构-功能分区、候选库与应用模块之间的目录组织。
sources.adoptedInEn: Platform MOF terminology, structure-function grouping, and organization between the Library and application modules.
sources.boundaryZh: 领域综述用于背景组织，不作为单个候选材料性能证据。
sources.boundaryEn: Domain-review background only; not performance evidence for an individual candidate.

sources.title: Carbon Dioxide Capture in Metal-Organic Frameworks
sources.authors: Kenji Sumida; David L. Rogow; Jarad A. Mason; Thomas M. McDonald; Eric D. Bloch; Z. R. Herm; Tae-Hyun Bae; Jeffrey R. Long
sources.coreIdeaZh: CO₂ 捕集材料需要同时关注孔结构、吸附位点、选择性、湿气和再生等因素。
sources.coreIdeaEn: CO2-capture materials require joint attention to pore structure, adsorption sites, selectivity, humidity, and regeneration.
sources.adoptedInZh: GasSep/EcoScreen 的 CO₂ 指标分解、水稳定性提示和吸附位点解释。
sources.adoptedInEn: CO2 metric decomposition, water-stability prompts, and adsorption-site interpretation in GasSep/EcoScreen.
sources.boundaryZh: 综述给出评价维度，不替代当前候选的同条件 IAST、GCMC 或实验结果。
sources.boundaryEn: The review motivates evaluation dimensions but does not replace same-condition IAST, GCMC, or experimental results for current candidates.

sources.title: Data-driven design of metal-organic frameworks for wet flue gas CO2 capture
sources.authors: Peter G. Boyd et al.
sources.coreIdeaZh: 湿烟气 CO₂ 捕集筛选必须把水稳定性、选择性、可再生性和任务条件纳入同一评估语境。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Wet flue-gas CO2 capture screening must place water stability, selectivity, regenerability, and task conditions in the same evaluation context.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 的水稳定/运行稳定需求、GasSep 条件上下文和缺字段提示。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen water/operational-stability requirements, GasSep condition context, and missing-field prompts.
sources.boundaryZh: 作为湿烟气筛选需求来源，不说明当前 Open MOF Seed 记录已经达到同等验证等级。
sources.boundaryEn: Used as a wet-flue-gas screening requirement source; it does not imply current Open MOF Seed records have equivalent validation level.

sources.title: Metal-organic framework materials as catalysts
sources.authors: JeongYong Lee; Omar K. Farha; John Roberts; Karl A. Scheidt; SonBinh T. Nguyen; Joseph T. Hupp
sources.coreIdeaZh: MOF 催化需要区分开放金属位点、孔限域、后修饰、客体进入和异相催化边界。
sources.coreIdeaEn: MOF catalysis requires distinguishing open metal sites, pore confinement, post-synthetic modification, guest access, and heterogeneous-catalysis boundaries.
sources.adoptedInZh: 催化实验室和有机酸模块的活性位点、腔内/表面机制与路径证据组织。
sources.adoptedInEn: Active-site, in-cavity/surface mechanism, and pathway-evidence organization in CatalysisLab and Organic Acid.
sources.boundaryZh: 领域综述不证明 CO₂ 到有机酸路径有效，只提供机制分类框架。
sources.boundaryEn: Domain-review background only; it does not prove CO2-to-organic-acid pathways and only provides a mechanism classification frame.

sources.title: Predicting reaction performance in C-N cross-coupling using machine learning
sources.authors: Daniel T. Ahneman; Jesús G. Estrada; Shishi Lin; Spencer D. Dreher; Abigail G. Doyle
sources.coreIdeaZh: 小样本反应机器学习需要反应条件、底物/催化剂描述符和外部验证一起呈现。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Small-data reaction machine learning needs reaction conditions, substrate/catalyst descriptors, and external validation to be presented together.
sources.adoptedInZh: 有机酸/催化链路的条件字段、验证队列和外部测试边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: Condition fields, validation queues, and external-test boundaries in Organic Acid / Catalysis workflows.
sources.boundaryZh: 研究对象是 C-N 偶联，不作为有机酸产物性能证据。
sources.boundaryEn: The reaction class is C-N cross-coupling, not Organic Acid production evidence.

sources.title: The FAIR Guiding Principles for scientific data management and stewardship
sources.authors: Mark D. Wilkinson et al.
sources.coreIdeaZh: 科学数据应可发现、可访问、可互操作、可复用，页面必须把来源、字段和边界展示清楚。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Scientific data should be findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable, so pages must expose sources, fields, and boundaries clearly.
sources.adoptedInZh: 全站字段级来源、数据质量审计、证据边界和用户可见来源链接。
sources.adoptedInEn: Platform field-level provenance, data-quality audit, evidence boundaries, and visible source links.
sources.boundaryZh: FAIR 是数据治理原则，不是任何候选材料性能或算法准确率证明。
sources.boundaryEn: FAIR is a data-governance principle, not proof of candidate performance or algorithm accuracy.

sources.title: Thermodynamics of mixed-gas adsorption
sources.authors: A. L. Myers; J. M. Prausnitz
sources.coreIdeaZh: IAST 用同温度纯组分吸附平衡估算理想吸附相中的混合物平衡。
sources.coreIdeaEn: IAST estimates ideal adsorbed-phase mixture equilibria from pure-component adsorption equilibria measured at the same temperature.
sources.adoptedInZh: GasSep 的 IAST 选择性定义、同温度纯组分等温线门控和混合物结果标识。
sources.adoptedInEn: GasSep IAST selectivity, temperature-matched pure-isotherm gates, and mixture-result labeling.
sources.boundaryZh: IAST 是热力学预测；缺少可比纯组分等温线时不计算，也不替代混合物或突破实验。
sources.boundaryEn: IAST is a thermodynamic prediction; it is not computed without comparable pure isotherms and does not replace mixture or breakthrough experiments.

sources.title: NIST Data Resources for Adsorption Science and Technology
sources.authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.coreIdeaZh: NIST 吸附资源把等温线、材料标识和原始文献链接组织为可追溯记录。
sources.coreIdeaEn: NIST adsorption resources organize isotherms, material identifiers, and source-publication links as traceable records.
sources.adoptedInZh: GasSep 的等温线来源、字段级 DOI/记录 ID，以及 MOF 候选库的气体数据关联。
sources.adoptedInEn: GasSep isotherm provenance, field-level DOI/record IDs, and gas-data links in the MOF Library.
sources.boundaryZh: 数据库记录不等于 NIST 对材料或平台排序的推荐；原始论文条款和实验条件仍需逐条核查。
sources.boundaryEn: A database record is not a NIST endorsement of a material or ranking; publication terms and experimental conditions still require record-level review.

sources.title: Advances, Updates, and Analytics for the Computation-Ready, Experimental Metal-Organic Framework Database: CoRE MOF 2019
sources.authors: Y. G. Chung; E. Haldoupis; B. J. Bucior; M. Haranczyk; S. Lee; H. Zhang et al.
sources.coreIdeaZh: CoRE MOF 2019 扩展并整理实验结构，用于先筛出较小候选集，再进行稳定性、脱溶剂和几何优化复核。
sources.coreIdeaEn: CoRE MOF 2019 expands and curates experimental structures for shortlist screening followed by stability, solvent-removal, and geometry checks.
sources.adoptedInZh: MOF 候选库的结构来源、几何描述符和“筛选后仍需逐结构复核”边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: MOF Library structural provenance, geometric descriptors, and the boundary that shortlisted structures still require record-level checks.
sources.boundaryZh: 可计算结构不自动代表可合成、稳定、已活化或适用于目标过程。
sources.boundaryEn: A computation-ready structure does not automatically establish synthesis feasibility, stability, activation, or process suitability.

sources.title: FAIR-MOFs: A Comprehensive Database for Accelerating the Discovery and Synthesis of Metal-Organic Frameworks
sources.authors: D. Wonanke; A. Longa; A. Pankajakshan et al.
sources.coreIdeaZh: FAIR-MOFs 把结构、几何优化和已报告合成条件连接起来，为逐候选补充路线、温度、时间和溶剂字段提供数据模型。
sources.coreIdeaEn: FAIR-MOFs links structures, geometry optimization, and reported synthesis conditions, offering a data model for route, temperature, time, and solvent fields.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 候选证据层和 MOF 候选库的合成字段占位、来源状态与缺失门控。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen candidate evidence and MOF Library synthesis-field placeholders, provenance status, and missing-data gates.
sources.boundaryZh: 该来源为未经过同行评审的预印本；只用于数据结构和候选补数路线，不作为环境或性能结论。
sources.boundaryEn: This source is an unreviewed preprint; it informs data structure and candidate data collection, not environmental or performance conclusions.

sources.title: Life Cycle Assessment of Silver, Copper, and Zinc-Based Metal-Organic Framework Products for Industry-Scale Production and Future Horizons
sources.authors: M. D. Firouzjaei; M. Pilevar; R. Todd; D. Williams et al.
sources.coreIdeaZh: 实验室与工业放大情景下，金属前驱体、溶剂、闭环回收和过程强化会改变 MOF 环境热点。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Across laboratory and industrial-scale scenarios, metal precursors, solvents, closed-loop recovery, and process intensification shift MOF environmental hotspots.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 将金属前驱体、溶剂回收和路线敏感性分开报告，并保留放大情景边界。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen reports metal precursors, solvent recovery, and route sensitivity separately while retaining scale-up scenario boundaries.
sources.boundaryZh: 研究对象和功能单位不能直接移植为其他 MOF 的候选清单或表征因子。
sources.boundaryEn: Its materials and functional units are not transplanted as inventories or characterization factors for other MOFs.

sources.title: Life cycle assessment of a layered metal-organic framework for supercapacitor applications
sources.authors: Chloe J. Balhatchet; Alexander C. Forse; Taylor Uekert
sources.coreIdeaZh: Cu3(HHTP)2 的摇篮到门初步 LCA 说明产率、洗涤溶剂和回收率必须作为可编辑情景与敏感性变量。
sources.coreIdeaEn: A preliminary cradle-to-gate LCA of Cu3(HHTP)2 shows why yield, washing solvents, and recovery must remain editable scenario and sensitivity variables.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 的产率、溶剂回收和研究现状结论区。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen yield, solvent-recovery, and research-status conclusion surfaces.
sources.boundaryZh: 只支持参数需求与敏感性设计，不把该材料的清单或比较结论转写到其他候选。
sources.boundaryEn: Supports parameter requirements and sensitivity design only; its inventory and comparative findings are not transferred to other candidates.

sources.title: ISO 14040 / ISO 14044 life-cycle assessment standards
sources.authors: International Organization for Standardization
sources.coreIdeaZh: LCA 需要目标与范围、功能单位、清单分析、影响评价和解释。
sources.coreIdeaEn: LCA requires goal and scope, functional unit, inventory analysis, impact assessment, and interpretation.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 只显示 LCA 数据准备度，不输出完整 LCA 结论。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen shows LCA readiness rather than complete LCA conclusions.
sources.boundaryZh: 早筛字段不等于标准化 LCA。
sources.boundaryEn: Early-screening fields are not a standards-compliant LCA.

sources.title: USGS critical minerals and EU critical raw materials lists
sources.authors: USGS; European Commission
sources.coreIdeaZh: 关键矿物和关键原料清单适合提示供应链复核，但不直接等于毒性、成本或 LCA 分数。
sources.coreIdeaEn: Critical-mineral and critical-raw-material lists are useful supply-chain review flags, but they are not toxicity, cost, or LCA scores.
sources.adoptedInZh: EcoScreen 将关键金属作为复核标签，而非直接扣分项。
sources.adoptedInEn: EcoScreen treats critical metals as review flags rather than direct score penalties.
sources.boundaryZh: 供应风险必须与候选任务、地区和用量一起解释。
sources.boundaryEn: Supply risk must be interpreted with task, region, and material demand.
